thread:
maria: Quick sync — I sketched an event-visibility roadmap for audit logs. Goal is to close coverage gaps for api-gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime and get a small validated customer test set. Posting notes + suggested owners. PTAL :eyes:

akash: Thanks — can you paste the short checklist here? want to align with the KMS/RBAC workstream too.

maria: Sure, high-level checklist below. Keeping it minimal for the quick triage: 
- inventory existing event types by service (severity + customer-facing flag)
- map schema fields we currently capture vs required for compliance (user_id, actor_type, request_id, resource_path, before/after, k8s_pod?)
- wire KMS context for events that include encrypted blobs
- create customer-validation harness (sample events + acceptance tests)
- schedule canary replay for 2 customer tenants

devon: I grabbed the api-gw inventory earlier. Short summary: we emit request.start, request.auth.result, request.quota.check, request.proxy.error. Missing: response.user_agent, response.content_hash, request.traceparent in some legacy paths.

jamie: For auth, we currently log login.success/failure, token.issue, token.revoke. We do NOT consistently log admin-role-changes and API key creations with before/after. That will bite compliance audits.

maria: yeah — owner suggestions: api-gw -> devon, auth -> jamie, console -> olivia, billing -> akash, runtime -> maria. Can we commit to owners doing a 15m triage and completing the inventory bullet by EOD Friday?

akash: ack scheduling. Also flagging RBAC change events — need to include both author and affected principal and delta. Will follow up with schema snippet.

olivia: console owners here. Quick note: console emits ui.click and admin.action but lacks structured resource identifiers (we just have freeform "target"). I can add structured resource_path but want to confirm canonical format. proposal: `service:/resource_type/resource_id`

maria: That format sounds good. Add `actor_type` and `actor_id` to every customer-facing event.

kompliance-bot: Reminder — per policy SEC-LOG-3, retention and searchable fields must include user_id, event_type, timestamp, request_id.

devon: On the schema side, prototyping a minimal change. Example: 
```json
{
  "event_type": "request.auth.result",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T15:20:10Z",
  "request_id": "req_01FZ...",
  "actor": { "actor_type": "service_account", "actor_id": "sa-123" },
  "resource_path": "api:/v1/customers/cus_456",
  "outcome": "denied",
  "metadata": { "reason": "rate_limit", "auth_method": "oauth2" }
}
```

jamie: That looks good. For RBAC changes we should add `before` / `after` tuples for roles. Example: `roles_before": ["read"], "roles_after": ["read","admin"]`. Avoid logging full role blobs — just diffs.

akash: KMS note — encrypted payloads should include `kms_key_id` and only store ciphertext. We must NOT log plaintext. Also attach `kms_context` when available for correlation.

maria: Next steps: owners to drop a short comment in this thread with inventory link + one-line gap summary by EOD Fri. I'll consolidate into a tickets list and create two canary tenants for validation.

olivia: will do, adding my inventory doc now: https://redwood-internal/docs/console-log-inventory (will post exact path once uploaded) :thumbsup:

devon: api-gw doc uploaded: https://redwood-internal/docs/api-gw-audit-inventory — missing traceparent on legacy lambda proxy routes flagged.

jamie: auth inventory link posted. I added a sample test harness with two golden events for role-change validation.

maria: perfect. if anyone hits blockers (schema migration risk, large retention cost), ping me + @akash. Otherwise i'll open the backlog tickets and tag owners. Thanks all :rocket:

akash: one quick ask — when you create tickets, please include an explicit smoke test that our customer test tenants can run (curl + sample event) so SRE can help monitor canary replays.

maria: noted. adding smoke tests field to ticket template.

kompliance-bot: New ticket template suggestion: "audit-coverage: <service> — inventory link, gaps, owner, smoke_test, retention_impact, kms_flags"

maria: Accepted. closing the loop here — followups in tickets.
